status: Local editorial candidate; not promoted or blind-playtested.

groups.title: For my executors
paragraphs: If I die before this gift is settled, read the unsigned papers. Artie will lose my donation rather than accept it without a board vote.
The family gets a board seat only if the gift is accepted. They already want the appointment while I am alive.
Sue has stopped my public announcement. My private toast can go ahead.
The bowl is off the market. The historic bottle stays on loan. Vincent will not let me print his painting. I can withhold his last payment.
Dada, I rejected your live stunt. I asked for a film. I have rejected that too.

groups.title: Unsigned announcement withdrawn
groups.text: Master: UNSIGNED / WITHDRAWN. Public copy held by coordinator. Separate private copy held by Grant.

groups.title: Gala settlement attachments
rows: Paid from restricted funds without approval.
Paid from another client’s commission advance.
Resin + metal powder. Label corrected; final payment reduced.
Materials: bronze powder + gold leaf. Sealing paper: NONE.
Condition: INTACT. Comparison used: DAMAGED object.
Workshop funds used. Paid weekend session CANCELED.

groups.title: Purchase condition and loan caption
groups.text: The purchase requires original contents, not an empty bottle or replica. Seller confirms contents retained; no cancellation or substitution received. Received before gala: closed bottle, dealer’s note, complete seller terms. Loan caption: “Contents inert.”

groups.title: Dr. Art E. Fact → Intake
groups.text: Seller requires original contents. Lender calls contents inert. Please clarify before opening.
groups.strike: Purchase condition requires original contents to remain.
groups.distribution: OUTGOING COPIES / Staff: full query, seller attachment, restriction. Press: Reed DeLabel’s marked caption.

groups.title: Labels, claims and access
rows: Staff keys: OPEN. Founder’s spare: OPEN.
Claimants’ letter + earlier acquisition advice. No ministry return order enclosed.
Old rule: publish before supporting papers arrive. Revised rule: review papers first.
Correction concerns the former owner’s name only. No claim of poison treatment.

groups.title: The interview begins
lines: SERVICE MANAGER: Mr. Larceny, I'll leave your glass here. I'm going back to the kitchen about that added course.
GRANT: Thank you. Paige, I asked for a quiet private place. Why have you followed me here?
PAIGE: You agreed to an interview about the gift. It's on the recorder.
GRANT: It's the gala. I'm announcing the gift tonight. Ask about that, or we'll speak tomorrow.
ROBIN: Grant, here is your copy. The museum already has one. Return the bowl intact or give the claimants a hearing.
GRANT: This is my private room, Robin, not the public podium. I'm already answering the reporter. I am not reading a petition here.

groups.title: Donor Collapse: studio master
groups.text: Original sound: “Jacket take” → chair scrape → clatter. Picture and sound received together. Podcast master: same sequence. Teaser starts after “Jacket take.”

groups.title: Original import retained
groups.text: Copied complete card after preview, before returning it. Import: physical bottle on open stand; no toast photograph. Photographer’s agency export supplied later.
groups.aside: Agency correction: earlier gallery photo was commercial, supplied as news. Public podium visible; disputed purchase cropped out.

groups.title: Final gallery copy
rows: Proposed transparent cover CANCELED on BOTH styling copies.
groups.note: Docent: “We returned to the public cases. We never entered Grant’s room or stopped at his place.”
